paragraphs.text: The Libration of Yotia was a campaign to liberate the province of Yotia from Fallaji control.

The campaign was forced upon Urza as the Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms after the slaughter of the Martyrs of Korlis . He and Tawnos assembled a large army consisting of rank soldiers, ornithopters , Yotian soldiers , avengers , clay statues , triskelions and tetravuses . The Fallaji fell back, burning the ground behind them, and by the end, the whole of Yotia save the heavily contested Sword Marches and trans- Mardun areas, were liberated. However, with Kroog long gone, the queen-in-exile, Kayla bin-Kroog , opted to remain in Penregon , and Urza pressed on into the Great Desert , starting his Tomakul Campaign , more focused on reaching Mishra in his new capital of Tomakul than he was in coddling the people of Yotia.
